description: Fetch the full text of a single narrative section from one SEC filing, selected by section code (e.g. business, risk-factors, mda). Prefer this over stocks_sections when you need just one section — it returns far less text. Discover the available section codes with stocks_sections and get accession numbers from stocks_filings.

section.description: Section code: business, risk-factors, legal-proceedings, mda, market-risk, ...

name: stocks_section
title: Filing section text
